inputs.name: DesktopIntegrityAdapter.update.app
inputs.description: The path to the experimental app bundle directory, whose Contents/Info.plist is copied and whose Contents/Frameworks/Codex Framework.framework/Codex Framework is symlinked into a temporary alias bundle. It must end with '/Codex Harness Experimental.app' (a slash before the name, no trailing slash), otherwise update rejects before creating any temporary directory.

outputs.name: DesktopIntegrityAdapter.update
outputs.description: Resolves with undefined once the read-back digest and the calculated digest both have used true and their sha256 digests are equal; the temporary directory is removed before the promise settles.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Integrity changes require the experimental application copy and an enabled ASAR integrity record.

errors.name: IntegrityDigestVerificationError
errors.description: The read-back integrity record is disabled or its SHA-256 digest differs from the calculated digest.

errors.name: Bundle filesystem or ASAR failure
errors.description: Filesystem calls and the ASAR library can fail without translation.
